NotiToCal reads the notifications of the apps you choose, for example WhatsApp, Signal, SMS or email.
If you like, also screenshots, shared pictures and texts, voice message transcripts (Anti-Vocale), IMAP mailboxes and Telegram.
Appointments and tasks it finds go to your calendar, your task app or other targets such as CalDAV, Todoist or Notion.
Anything uncertain is not simply added: you get a question and decide yourself.
1. Capture: the notification or screenshot is read, pictures with on-device text recognition.
2. Pre-filter: rules check offline whether there is a date, a time or an appointment or task word at all. Ads, codes and system messages drop out here.
3. Analysis: rules, the on-device AI or an external AI determine kind, title, time and place.
4. Checks: your strictness settings decide on confidence, past dates and how far ahead. Duplicates are merged instead of added twice.
5. Place: “at the Italian place on Main Street” becomes an address, from earlier appointments, your location history or OpenStreetMap.
6. Add or ask: what is certain is added automatically, everything else is shown as a suggestion.
Rules (offline): instant, no internet, no download, in 7 languages. Good for clear messages with date and time.
On-device AI: a small language model runs on your phone. Nothing leaves the device, but analysis takes longer and uses more battery.
External AI (cloud provider or your own server): understands even difficult messages best, but message texts leave the device.
The rules always check along: date, time and place come from the text when it contains them, so no AI can invent a weekday.
First your earlier appointments are checked for where such meetings took place.
Then the location history on the device: it is searched through an index and returns at most 3 matching places, even with thousands saved.
Only when a street is named (or you have been there) is anything looked up online, and only a coarse position (about 1 km) goes to OpenStreetMap.
The location history never goes to an AI. Only the place found goes into the appointment.
NotiToCal only sees what a notification contains. Shortened or bundled notifications and chats that are open while the message arrives give little or nothing.
Rules understand typical phrasing, but no irony and no arrangements spread over many messages.
